cabins.label: Guest cabins
cabins.assumption: Between Walden's 15 tents and the Presidio's 14 rooms [^25,27], small enough to fill midweek with one retreat group and weekends with couples.

site_acres.label: Site area, acres (hypothetical parcel)
site_acres.assumption: Fifteen acres hold 14 cabins, a lodge, parking and the septic field on well and septic service, with room to keep cabins apart and screened from neighbors. The parcel, its jurisdiction and its utilities are hypothetical and are conditions to confirm.

land_per_acre.label: Land allowance per acre
land_per_acre.assumption: An allowance, not a price found for any parcel. The one corridor ask the study uses, 26 acres with a 2,280 sq ft building and more than 500 ft of frontage at $3,198,000 when posted December 10, 2024 [^6], works out to about $123,000 an acre with the building included; raw acreage with no building, well or drive should price below that, so the study carries $95,000 an acre. An appraisal with corridor sales replaces it before the loan is sized.

cabin_cost.label: Cost per cabin, built and set
cabin_cost.assumption: No per-cabin cost is published for the Hill Country. Census put the 2025 South average for new single-family homes at $155.62 per sq ft before land [^38], and NAHB put the 2024 West South Central custom-home median at $138 [^39]. A small cabin carries a full bath, kitchenette, deck and hot tub in a fraction of a house's floor area, so we carry $120,000 per unit.

lodge_cost.label: Lodge with meeting hall, prep kitchen and restrooms
lodge_cost.assumption: Sized to seat about 100 for a banquet, the capacity Walden markets [^26]. No published benchmark.

site_work.label: Well, septic, electric extension, roads and parking
site_work.assumption: No water or sewer provider was found for the corridor, so the model assumes a well and septic system, an electric line extension, roads and parking; an allowance pending a civil engineer's estimate and the groundwater district's permit.

soft_pct.label: Soft costs, share of hard cost
soft_pct.assumption: Design, engineering, county and state permits, legal, appraisal and construction interest.

ffe_per_cabin.label: Furnishings per cabin
ffe_per_cabin.assumption: Working allowance for furniture, linens, kitchenware and televisions.

lodge_ffe.label: Lodge furniture and event equipment
lodge_ffe.assumption: Tables, chairs, audio-visual and kitchen equipment for retreat groups.

working_capital.label: Pre-opening and working capital
working_capital.assumption: Marketing, payroll and utilities before bookings reach the Year 1 level.

adr.label: Cabin average daily rate
adr.assumption: No ADR is published for the trade area. Carter Creek's lowest nightly prices for the week of October 12, 2026 ran $120 on Wednesday to $293 on Saturday, plus a $28.25 resort fee [^18,19]; Walden showed $208 a night for October 15 to 16, 2026 and $329 and up in October 2026 [^23,24]. Glamping operators reported a 2025 ADR of $338 for cabins and tiny homes [^37]. We set $265 in Year 1, rising about 3% a year.

occupancy.label: Cabin occupancy
occupancy.assumption: AirDNA expects U.S. short-term rental occupancy of 57.4% in 2026 [^36]. Wine-trail demand is weekend-heavy (a Carter Creek review is titled "Don't stay on weekdays!" [^20]), so the ramp reaches 56% only as retreat groups fill midweek nights.

events.label: Retreats, weddings and group events per year
events.assumption: No event count, festival attendance or hotel tax series exists in the record. One event about every 11 days at stabilization, against Carter Creek's large event plant and Walden's 100-seat banquet room [^17,26].

event_fee.label: Venue and package fee per event
event_fee.assumption: Venue rental, coordination and catering margin per event; no local benchmark. Rises 3% a year.

other_pct.label: Pet fees, rentals and retail, share of cabin revenue
other_pct.assumption: Carter Creek charges a pet fee of $84.75 a stay [^19]; small ancillary income.

payroll.label: Payroll and benefits (Year 1)
payroll.assumption: A working general manager, housekeepers, a maintenance hand and an event coordinator. No local wage data is in the record. Fixed, rising 3% a year.

housekeeping_per_night.label: Laundry and guest supplies per occupied night
housekeeping_per_night.assumption: Linen service, amenities and consumables per occupied cabin night; housekeeping labor sits in payroll. No published benchmark.

commission_pct.label: Booking commissions and marketing, share of cabin revenue
commission_pct.assumption: Online travel agency and platform commissions on part of the bookings, plus paid listings.

event_cost_pct.label: Direct event costs, share of event revenue
event_cost_pct.assumption: Rentals, extra staff and catering cost passed through on events.

util_rm_pct.label: Utilities, repairs and grounds, share of revenue
util_rm_pct.assumption: Electric, propane, well and septic service, hot tub service and grounds.

ga_pct.label: Administration, software and professional fees, share of revenue
ga_pct.assumption: Reservation software, accounting, legal and HOT filing.

reserve_pct.label: Replacement reserve, share of revenue
reserve_pct.assumption: Hot tubs, decks, furnishings and roofs wear quickly on small cabins.

insurance.label: Insurance (Year 1)
insurance.assumption: Site wind, flood and wildfire insurance conditions were NOT FOUND. The Pedernales reached its highest level since 1979 in July 2026 [^34], so the lender must replace this with a bound quote.

tax_county.label: Blanco County tax rate, 2025 (per $1 of value)

sba_guaranty_pct.label: SBA guaranty share, loans of $350,001 to $5 million

rate_7a.label: 7(a) interest rate
rate_7a.assumption: Prime was 7.00% on October 9, 2026 [^43]. SBA caps the spread over Prime by loan size [^41]; 2025 7(a) loans to bed-and-breakfasts averaged 9.49% [^45]. We carry Prime plus 2.5 points. The lender sets the rate at pricing

growth_payroll.label: Payroll growth per year
growth_payroll.assumption: Payroll grows 3% a year, a labelled allowance for wage growth; the research gives no local wage trend for this use, so the lender should test it against the operator's staffing plan.

growth_housekeeping.label: Housekeeping cost growth per year
growth_housekeeping.assumption: Housekeeping cost per occupied night grows 3% a year, a labelled allowance in line with the payroll assumption.

growth_insurance.label: Insurance growth per year
growth_insurance.assumption: Insurance grows 5% a year, a labelled allowance; no quoted premium for the subject exists, so a bound quote replaces it before closing.

growth_tax.label: Taxable value growth per year
growth_tax.assumption: Taxable value grows 2% a year, a labelled allowance; Texas appraisal districts reappraise, and the study does not forecast the district's value.

uses.label: Well, septic, electric, roads and parking

revenue.label: Cabin revenue
revenue.basis: cabins x 365 x occupancy x ADR

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * land_per_acre + (cabins * cabin_cost + lodge_cost + site_work) * (1 + contingency_pct)) * (tax_county + tax_isd + tax_esd + tax_gcd) * (1 + growth_tax) ** y

proposed.note: the sponsor proposes a single 25-year 7(a) loan at the start-up minimum
